scope: Shared Java policy/queue/controller behavior; actual native reclamation remains unrun.

acceptance.root_cause: All live attempts retain memory while waiting for allocation permission; no unblocked peer can complete to relieve the condition.
acceptance.behavior: Normal admission and STOPPING guard remain first. An all-allocation-waiting WAIT selects the newest blocked peer while protecting oldest denial; with one blocked attempt it selects that attempt. Existing queue owns termination/reaping, immutable accepted outcomes, stable submission order and one completion-free retry per action.

retained_red.red_predicate: Actual WAIT differs from required TERMINATE in exact headroom=100,available=499,oldest peak=500,resident=100 snapshot. Compilation/setup succeeded.

limits: BLOCKED reports a native allocation wait, not suspension or lack of useful progress in every thread. Reclamation is the approved conservative targeted retry policy; it can discard work in other threads.

Tests use in-memory Measurements and Attempt owners. They prove production requests, state transitions, sequence retention, cleanup barriers and bounded retry decisions, not OS kill behavior, real RSS release, native allocation success or build-output reuse.
All owned trees can be released yet current external memory/pressure still prevents retry. This remains WAIT without consuming allowance, never a claim the task cannot complete.

The existing completion-free retry bound stops another eligible START before owner acquisition. It does not solve repeated granted allocations that reblock, make an uncertain peak known, or guarantee eventual completion.
No native adapter, Cargo/Bazel integration, monitor, workflow, dependency or upstream source changed. No remote run, commit, push or issue mutation.

native_gate.status: unrun; prerequisite production attempt/measurement composition remains required
native_gate.case: Two real allocator fixture attempts retain touched pages and publish authentic allocation waits. Observe one peer termination, no further effect until accepted whole-tree reaping/cleanup, then fresh capacity measurement, oldest grant and actual allocation success. Preserve and reuse an earlier completed build output.
native_gate.receipt: Bind actual packaged Java artifact, stable action, attempt ordinal, native installation/wait identity, owned root and descendants, host/effective budget, pre/post residency, accepted whole outcome, cleanup, next sample, grant and allocation result.
native_gate.negative: A surviving descendant after root exit must retain STOPPING. Ordinary compiler failure must not become an inferred memory abort.
native_gate.portability: A platform-specific native result establishes that platform only.
